summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a payable settlement agreement with Encore DEC, LLC, a related party owned by controlling shareholder Randy Soule. Under the agreement, approximately $16.7 million in accounts payable will be settled by issuing 37,033,386 shares of Class A Common Stock at a conversion price of $0.451 per share, based on a formula using average closing prices. Post-conversion, Soule will own ~30.56% of the outstanding Class A Common Stock. The transaction is a debt-for-equity swap, not an acquisition, tender, or going-private event. Watch for potential dilution effects and the board's continued reliance on related-party transactions.
